text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- The number of tuberculosis cases in Portugal is three times the EU average.
- Tension between staff of Prime Minister Antonio Guterres and President Jorge Sampaio at the Ibero-American summit in Chile.
Portugal could be a transit point for the illegal export of arms to central Africa, according to a report in Spain's "El Pais" newspaper.
- Inspectorate-General of Health to investigate private clinics in Portugal. Some clinics are suspected of having no licence.
- President Sampaio raises the issue of self-determination for the people of East Timor at the Ibero-American summit in Chile.
- A Portuguese foreign ministry source denied a report that arms were exported illegally from this country to central Africa.
